title: MWCC allocator capture and analysis
description: Capture what MWCC decided for one function: native traced-compiler decisions, coloring snapshots and source-variant diffs, or stock PCode/allocator stages under qemu; analyze saved evidence offline.
status_message: Live runner v1: qemu captures use the stock hash-gated MWCC under qemu-i386 with a synchronous gdb-multiarch driver; native captures and compare_sources use the traced MWCC build (build/compilers-traced/GC/<ver>) and require its object to equal the stock object.
limitations: --backend auto picks per capture: pcode, coloring, pair and trace stay on qemu (they need PCode blocks); coloring-native, decisions and compare_sources run on the native traced compiler.

Native captures need a validated traced build of the unit's compiler version (native/CAPABILITIES.json, or CAPABILITIES.json beside the traced binaries); a trace point that version lacks is listed in unavailable_points, never reported empty.
Every native compile is checked against a stock compile of the same sources; a traced/stock object mismatch is reported as unavailable, never as a diff.
Traced compiles disable the MWCC object cache (MWCC_CACHE_DISABLE=1) and write the trace to a file, never stderr. Compiles have a deadline with process-group cleanup and output/trace size caps.
Qemu capture is Linux sandbox-only and can take minutes; offline analysis also runs on macOS.
Qemu allocator addresses are valid only for hash-gated GC/1.2.5 and GC/1.2.5n binaries.

Qemu trace uses the current object function index when compiler names are absent, checks decoded names and object order, and reports the remaining symbol-order caveat. Native captures select the function by name.
Offline solver results require baseline replay agreement and real compile/checkdiff verification. Searches have fixed time and input limits.
Qemu trace defaults to stages and graphs. Full event, creation and stack tracing is opt-in; omitted event classes are explicitly listed.
Analysis always saves a full workspace artifact and returns at most 8 KiB of result facts.

usage.agent_guidance: Use the native decisions capture to see what MWCC decided for a candidate (vreg owners and declaration sites, coloring per class and pass, inlining, CSE, frame) and compare_sources to measure what an edit changes. Use qemu trace for PCode stages, then analyze with provenance, explain, inverse, source-rank, stack or origins; validate baseline replay before using solver hypotheses.
